description: Kicks off a run of a Task and returns at once; the run carries on by itself and is live on the task's page. When the task expects an input document (its trigger has an input), pass the user's material as `input` — pasted text, extracted attachment text, or JSON. Tell the user it has started and what it does next. Check where it stands with workbench_tasks_run_view when they ask; don't poll it in a loop.

approvalId.description: Approval id from a prior needs_confirmation response. Omit on the first call.

input.description: Trigger payload — the document text / JSON the task starts from.

workspace.description: Workspace slug. Personal tokens with no default workspace MUST pass this; tokens with a default can override per call. Ignored for workspace API keys.

name: workbench_tasks_start
title: Start a Task run
